messages:
laura: Quick q — we keep losing partner visibility on warm marketplace leads (they go straight to AE). Can we define a lightweight 'SI intake stamp' + routing so partners get notified and can claim?

mike: Yes. Minimal CRM stamp: source=marketplace, partner_flag=si_candidate, partner_owner_hint, joint_announce_intent. Then claim window.

asha: Suggest 24h claim SLA. If no partner claim, auto-assign to partner-queue (pilot option). Also urgent accounts (<48h response) should bypass auto-assign and go to AE + partner notif.

ben-salesops: Automation plan: 1) marketplace webhook creates lead with stamp; 2) apply tags and ARR banding; 3) start 24h timer; 4) send partner_offer webhook; 5) on partner_ack -> assign; partner_decline -> fallback routing. I'll draft the runbook.

priya-silead: Don't forget account mapping: domain heuristics + ARR band to pick enterprise vs. midmarket SI lanes. ARR >250k -> human triage (2h SLA). Also mark hw_interest early.

chad-gtm: Add joint_announce checkbox on intake so GTM can sync messaging early if it's PR-worthy or co-marketable.

marketplace-bot: New marketplace lead created: lead_id=MP-11872, org=Greenleaf.ai, arr_est=350000, tags=[marketplace, needs-si]

laura: Good callout. Ben — can you own the automation + Confluence doc (intake webhook schema, partner_ack endpoint, fallback rules)? I'll run partner ops and pilot coordination.

ben-salesops: Yep. Draft by EOD tomorrow. Sample webhook payload I'll include: ```{"lead_id":"MP-11872","source":"marketplace","partner_hint":"greenleaf-int","arr_est":350000,"joint_announce_intent":false}```

asha: Routing rules proposal: ARR >250k -> enterprise-si bucket; 100k-250k -> regional AE + partner notify; <100k -> partner nurture/self-serve.

priya-silead: Also add hw_order and nda_required flags so legal / partner-ops get looped and SLA paused until NDA.

mike: Updating intake form to add fields: joint_announce_intent, hw_order, nda_required, partner_hint.

priya-silead: Can partners accept/decline via a partner portal webhook? If partners can decline, we won't waste AE time.

ben-salesops: Plan: POST /partner/offer -> partner posts /partner/ack or /partner/decline -> CRM updates. We'll include partner bandwidth metadata so we don't spam overloaded partners.

chad-gtm: Rollout: pilot with 3 SIs + marketplace sellers next week. Need analytics: time to claim, ack rate, conversion. Who volunteers?

priya-silead: I'll coordinate AtlasOne + Symmetry, propose Clearpath as third.

laura: Locking pilot: AtlasOne, Symmetry, Clearpath. Ben add pilot flag and analytics events. We'll reconvene after 1 week of pilot to review metrics and iterate.

ben-salesops: Added pilot flag, event tracking and sample dashboard metrics. Posting Confluence link when draft is ready. :thumbsup:

marketplace-bot: Automation engaged (pilot mode): intake MP-11872 routed to partner-queue.

laura: Thanks everyone — action items: Ben runbook + Confluence, Priya partner coordination, Mike intake form changes, Pilot next week. Tagging @chad-gtm for GTM readiness.
